reason: I need fixtures in hand within a week or two for my electrician, and 2 to 3 weeks of delivery doesn't work for that. The UL listing and the returns are reassuring, but I've never heard of this store and it has almost no reviews.
objection: 2 to 3 weeks is too slow for my electrician date, and I'm not putting several hundred dollars on a brand-new store with hardly any reviews when a late fixture holds up the whole job. 10% back for lateness doesn't fix a missed install.
would_change_my_mind: A guaranteed in-stock delivery date within 7 to 10 days, or a few in-stock pieces that ship in days.
